tool_reading.claim: HOOMD-blue adopts no system of units: it follows a self-consistent one on three base units, energy, length and mass, from which time, force and pressure are derived
loci: Units, sections Base Units and Unit Conversion (mat-20261120-hoomd-7.2.2-units)

tool_reading.claim: md.bond.Harmonic gives each bond the energy U(r) = k (r - r0)^2 / 2, with k the potential constant in energy per length squared and r0 the rest length, set per bond type in params
md.methods.ConstantVolume integrates by velocity Verlet and, with a thermostat, samples a canonical ensemble; with none, constant energy
hoomd from conda-forge, at the version values_read names, ran the adapter's script on molecules with a harmonic bond and reported the bonds' energy, the potential energy and the kinetic temperature

contract.name: install_environment
contract.description: make this agent's own environment once, before the first run: the package hoomd (HOOMD-blue) at the version conda-forge offered when the agent was built, with its Python, installed with pixi from conda-forge into runs/env; the runner points pixi's caches at runs/cache

python.description: the path of the environment's interpreter, relative to this directory

version.description: the version of hoomd the environment holds, read from its conda-meta record

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call

error_contracts.message: pixi install of hoomd from conda-forge did not give its interpreter

remediation.action: read the evidence; a network or channel problem may pass on a retry

error_contracts.message: conda-forge offers no hoomd for this platform

remediation.action: run this agent on osx-arm64, osx-64, linux-64 or linux-aarch64

contract.name: run_h2_md
contract.description: run HOOMD-blue on H2 molecules placed on a simple cubic grid in a cubic box, each held together by a harmonic bond, md.bond.Harmonic, with no force between molecules; momenta drawn at kT and constant-volume dynamics with the Bussi thermostat at kT; every value is in HOOMD-blue's own units, whose scales envelope/handovers.json records; a new folder under runs/md for each run; returns what HOOMD-blue reports: the bonds' energy, the potential energy and the kinetic temperature at the end, and the kinetic temperature and potential energy logged along the run

bond_k.description: the bond's potential constant k; the value src/handover.py values prints for the row bond_k

bond_r0.description: the bond's rest length r0; the value src/handover.py values prints for the row bond_r0

particle_mass.description: the mass of each hydrogen atom

box_side.description: the side of the cubic box

kT.description: the thermal energy the momenta are drawn at and the thermostat holds

steps.description: how many steps the run takes

log_every.description: how many steps between two logged values

seed.description: the random seed of the momenta and the thermostat

budget_s.description: the running time the run may take before the call gives up on it, counted while it runs and not while it is paused; no limit when null

bond_energy.description: the bonds' energy HOOMD-blue reports at the end, md.bond.Harmonic's energy

potential_energy.description: the potential energy HOOMD-blue reports at the end

kinetic_temperature.description: the kinetic temperature HOOMD-blue reports at the end, as an energy

series.description: step, kinetic_temperature and potential_energy as HOOMD-blue reported them at each logged step

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call

error_contracts.message: a value the run needs is missing or not one the contract takes

remediation.action: give every value; bond_k and bond_r0 are what src/handover.py values prints for their rows, and a row no hand-over filled is the person's to give

error_contracts.message: this agent's environment is not made

remediation.action: call install_environment first, then this call again

error_contracts.message: the rest length is not shorter than the box side

remediation.action: give a box side longer than the rest length

error_contracts.message: the run ended with a failure status or wrote no result

remediation.action: read run.err in the run folder

error_contracts.message: the call gave up on the run after its budget of running time and stopped it

remediation.action: call again with a larger budget_s, or none

error_contracts.message: the run was stopped from outside

remediation.action: call again with the same input to start the run over
